verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.pt: Então respondeu Bildade, o suíta, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
verses.en_bbe: Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

verses.en: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
verses.pt: Até quando falarás tais coisas, e até quando serão as palavras da tua boca qual vento impetuoso?
verses.en_web: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
verses.en_bbe: How long will you say these things, and how long will the words of your mouth be like a strong wind?

verses.en: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.pt: Perverteria Deus o direito? Ou perverteria o Todo-Poderoso a justiça?
verses.en_web: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
verses.en_bbe: Does God give wrong decisions? or is the Ruler of all not upright in his judging?

verses.en: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
verses.pt: Se teus filhos pecaram contra ele, ele os entregou ao poder da sua transgressão.
verses.en_web: If your children have sinned against him, He has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
verses.en_bbe: If your children have done evil against him, then their punishment is from his hand.

verses.en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
verses.pt: Mas, se tu com empenho buscares a Deus, e ,ao Todo-Poderoso fizeres a tua súplica,
verses.en_web: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
verses.en_bbe: If you will make search for God with care, and put your request before the Ruler of all;

verses.en: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
verses.pt: se fores puro e reto, certamente mesmo agora ele despertará por ti, e tornará segura a habitação da tua justiça.
verses.en_web: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
verses.en_bbe: If you are clean and upright; then he will certainly be moved to take up your cause, and will make clear your righteousness by building up your house again.

verses.en: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
verses.pt: Embora tenha sido pequeno o teu princípio, contudo o teu último estado aumentará grandemente.
verses.en_web: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
verses.en_bbe: And though your start was small, your end will be very great.

verses.en: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
verses.pt: Indaga, pois, eu te peço, da geração passada, e considera o que seus pais descobriram.
verses.en_web: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
verses.en_bbe: Put the question now to the past generations, and give attention to what has been searched out by their fathers:

verses.en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
verses.pt: Porque nós somos de ontem, e nada sabemos, porquanto nossos dias sobre a terra, são uma sombra.
verses.en_web: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
verses.en_bbe: (For we are but of yesterday, and have no knowledge, because our days on earth are gone like a shade:)

verses.en: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.pt: Não te ensinarão eles, e não te falarão, e do seu entendimento não proferirão palavras?
verses.en_web: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.en_bbe: Will they not give you teaching, and say words of wisdom to you?

verses.en: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
verses.pt: Pode o papiro desenvolver-se fora de um pântano. Ou pode o junco crescer sem água?
verses.en_web: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
verses.en_bbe: Will the river-plant come up in its pride without wet earth? will the grass get tall without water?

verses.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
verses.pt: Quando está em flor e ainda não cortado, seca-se antes de qualquer outra erva.
verses.en_web: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
verses.en_bbe: When it is still green, without being cut down, it becomes dry and dead before any other plant.

verses.en: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:
verses.pt: Assim são as veredas de todos quantos se esquecem de Deus; a esperança do ímpio perecerá,
verses.en_web: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man shall perish,
verses.en_bbe: So is the end of all who do not keep God in mind; and the hope of the evil-doer comes to nothing:

verses.en: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.
verses.pt: a sua segurança se desfará, e a sua confiança será como a teia de aranha.
verses.en_web: Whose confidence shall break apart, Whose trust is a spider’s web.
verses.en_bbe: Whose support is cut off, and whose hope is no stronger than a spider's thread.

verses.en: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
verses.pt: Encostar-se-á à sua casa, porém ela não subsistirá; apegar-se-lhe-á, porém ela não permanecerá.
verses.en_web: He shall lean on his house, but it shall not stand. He shall cling to it, but it shall not endure.
verses.en_bbe: He is looking to his family for support, but it is not there; he puts his hope in it, but it comes to nothing.

verses.en: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
verses.pt: Ele está verde diante do sol, e os seus renovos estendem-se sobre o seu jardim;
verses.en_web: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
verses.en_bbe: He is full of strength before the sun, and his branches go out over his garden.

verses.en: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.
verses.pt: as suas raízes se entrelaçam junto ao monte de pedras; até penetra o pedregal.
verses.en_web: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
verses.en_bbe: His roots are twisted round the stones, forcing their way in between them.

verses.en: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.
verses.pt: Mas quando for arrancado do seu lugar, então este o negará, dizendo: Nunca te vi.
verses.en_web: If he is destroyed from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
verses.en_bbe: If he is taken away from his place, then it will say, I have not seen you.

verses.en: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
verses.pt: Eis que tal é a alegria do seu caminho; e da terra outros brotarão.
verses.en_web: Behold, this is the joy of his way: out of the earth, others shall spring.
verses.en_bbe: Such is the joy of his way, and out of the dust another comes up to take his place.

verses.en: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
verses.pt: Eis que Deus não rejeitará ao reto, nem tomará pela mão os malfeitores;
verses.en_web: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, God will not give up him who is without sin, and will not take evil-doers by the hand.

verses.en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
verses.pt: ainda de riso te encherá a boca, e os teus lábios de louvor.
verses.en_web: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.
verses.en_bbe: The time will come when your mouth will be full of laughing, and cries of joy will come from your lips.

verses.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
verses.pt: Teus aborrecedores se vestirão de confusão; e a tenda dos ímpios não subsistirá.
verses.en_web: Those who hate you shall be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked shall be no more.”
verses.en_bbe: Your haters will be clothed with shame, and the tent of the sinner will not be seen again.
